Container.Name: plex-gonic-playlist-sync
Container.Overview: Synchronise playlist membership, names and track order between Plex and Gonic over their HTTP APIs. No music files are copied or modified. CLI + polling scheduler + authenticated web UI.
Container.Description:
Plex ↔ Gonic Playlist Sync keeps playlists in sync between a Plex music library and a Gonic (Subsonic/OpenSubsonic) server using only their HTTP APIs.
• Mirrors membership, names and exact track order (including repeated tracks). • Never copies, downloads, transcodes or deletes music files. • Deterministic, explainable track matching across different container paths (sync.path_roots). • Dry-run preview; guarded writes with snapshots, journal and read-back verification. • Directional or bidirectional with explicit baseline and conflict detection. • Web UI with login + CSRF; polling scheduler; CLI.
FIRST RUN 1. Fill in Plex and Gonic connection details and the UI password below. 2. Set PATH ROOTS so the same files are mapped for each server. 3. Open the Web UI, create a mapping, and use Preview before Sync. 4. Or open a console and run: playlist-sync doctor ; playlist-sync sync --all --dry-run
NETWORKING Service names such as "plex" and "gonic" resolve only on a user-defined Docker network. Set Network to the same custom network as those containers, or use reachable host/LAN addresses (e.g. http://192.168.1.10:32400).
The UI refuses to start without a UI password, by design.

Config.Name: Data path
Config.Description: SQLite state, snapshots, baselines and run history.

Config.Name: Plex URL
Config.Description: Base URL of Plex as reachable from this container.

Config.Name: Plex Music Libraries
Config.Description: JSON list of music library names or keys to scope discovery, e.g. ["Music"]. Empty = all.

Config.Name: Gonic URL
Config.Description: Base URL of Gonic as reachable from this container.

Config.Name: Gonic Password
Config.Description: Gonic/Subsonic password. Token auth is used; the password is not sent per request.

Config.Name: Path Roots (JSON)
Config.Description: Map the same files as each server sees them, e.g. [{"name":"music","plex_root":"/data/music","gonic_root":"/music"}]. Required for reliable matching.

Config.Name: Poll seconds
Config.Description: Scheduler interval in seconds. 0 disables the scheduler (manual/UI only).

Config.Name: Block on unmatched
Config.Description: Block a playlist write if any source track is unmatched or ambiguous (recommended).

Config.Name: Allow clear target when source empty
Config.Description: Allow an empty source to clear a populated target. Off by default.

Config.Name: Duration tolerance (ms)
Config.Description: Duration tolerance used by metadata matching, in milliseconds.

Config.Name: UI Password
Config.Description: Web UI login password. REQUIRED: the service will not start without it.
